messages:
zoe.docs: Quick sync  I'm revising the SOC2 audit-log docs to clarify language around cross-region backups and retention presets. Also spotted a dead link to the Node SDK audit export example. Can legal + eng sanity-check before I open a PR?

harry.legal: Good catch. Keep the tone cautious and avoid implying automatic cross-region storage. Suggest: "Audit logs are retained according to tenant-configured retention settings. Where copies are created across regions for backup or failover, the same retention and access controls apply and key residency is respected per tenant configuration."

meera.eng: Tech confirmation: replication is DR-triggered for tenants without residency restrictions. Replicas inherit TTL metadata so they expire with the primary retention. When copying across regions we re-encrypt using the customer's CMK if configured; otherwise we use our managed key.

prudence.pm: product ask: can we add small migration notes for customers who used numeric presets previously (e.g., 30d -> "short", 365d -> "standard") so Console UX can show a helpful tooltip?

zoe.docs: drafting bullets now. Also I'll swap the Node example link to /sdk-node/examples/auditExport.js (not raw). Draft text: 
- Preset "short" (30 days): stored in-region by default; no replication unless DR requested.
- Preset "standard" (365 days): may be replicated for DR purposes; replicas observe the same TTL and access controls.

meera.eng: nit: change "no replication unless DR requested" -> "no replication by default; replicas may be created for DR purposes".

harry.legal: tiny edit request: replace "may be replicated" with "may be replicated for disaster recovery" for clarity.

zoe.docs: updated. Node SDK snippet (pointing to example):
```js
const Redwood = require('redwood-sdk')
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY, region: 'eu-west-1' })
// uses customer-managed KMS in region when configured
const res = await client.auditLogs.export({ tenantId: 't-789', retentionDays: 365 })
console.log(res.url)
```

link-bot: Suggested PR title: "docs: clarify cross-region backup wording, preset migration guide, fix Node SDK example link"

prudence.pm: this looks good. For the Console tooltip: "Presets map to recommended retention windows; visit docs for region and key-management details." I'll file a small follow-up ticket.

zoe.docs: thanks everyone. I'll open PR in ~20m and include a migration table mapping numeric -> named presets plus links to SDK examples. PR will also mention contacting Sales for Private deployments with strict residency.

meera.eng: i'll add a repo redirect for the old Node path and ping when done.

zoe.docs: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1087 — closing thread after merge, will loop back if legal asks for changes. :white_check_mark:
